name: After Hours #22 — Boardwalk Closed
description: Shutters down, ocean loud. The lights stayed on as a courtesy to nobody. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 22 is unlimited: anyone can mint this loop. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of looping lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever. Hand-illustrated stills, then animated into 3-second analog loops with grain, weather, and lamp flicker.
